meanings.en: eager or ready to fight or argue
meanings.exampleEn: He was in a combative mood and challenged everyone's opinion.
meanings.exampleTr: Kavgacı bir ruh halindeydi ve herkesin fikrine karşı çıktı.

meanings.en: relating to farming or the ownership of land
meanings.exampleEn: The country still has a largely agrarian economy.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke hâlâ büyük ölçüde tarımsal bir ekonomiye sahip.

meanings.en: the act of preparing land and growing crops
meanings.exampleEn: The cultivation of rice requires plenty of water.
meanings.exampleTr: Pirinç yetiştirme bol su gerektirir.

meanings.en: the farming of animals and crops
meanings.exampleEn: Animal husbandry has been practiced for thousands of years.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayvancılık binlerce yıldır yapılmaktadır.

meanings.en: something that makes progress difficult
meanings.exampleEn: The heavy rain was a hindrance to our travel plans.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmur seyahat planlarımıza bir engeldi.

meanings.en: something that blocks a passage or progress
meanings.exampleEn: A fallen tree caused an obstruction on the road.
meanings.exampleTr: Devrilen bir ağaç yolda bir engele neden oldu.

meanings.en: air conditioning, a system that cools air
meanings.exampleEn: Please turn on the AC; it's very hot in here.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen klimayı aç; burası çok sıcak.

meanings.en: a person or thing that carries something
meanings.exampleEn: The mosquito is a carrier of the disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Sivrisinek hastalığın taşıyıcısıdır.

meanings.en: a strong alcoholic drink
meanings.exampleEn: He bought a bottle of liquor for the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Parti için bir şişe sert içki aldı.

meanings.en: strong distilled alcoholic drinks
meanings.exampleEn: The bar serves a wide range of spirits.
meanings.exampleTr: Bar çok çeşitli sert içkiler sunuyor.

meanings.en: alcoholic drink (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: They brought plenty of booze to the celebration.
meanings.exampleTr: Kutlamaya bolca içki getirdiler.

meanings.en: causing drunkenness or great excitement
meanings.exampleEn: The wine had an intoxicating effect on the guests.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarabın misafirler üzerinde sarhoş edici bir etkisi vardı.

meanings.en: containing no alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: They offered several nonalcoholic drinks at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partide birkaç alkolsüz içecek sundular.

meanings.en: excessively sensitive physically or emotionally
meanings.exampleEn: She is hypersensitive to criticism about her work.
meanings.exampleTr: İşiyle ilgili eleştirilere karşı aşırı duyarlıdır.

meanings.en: protected against a disease or not affected by something
meanings.exampleEn: After the vaccine, she became immune to the virus.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşıdan sonra virüse karşı bağışık oldu.

meanings.en: an amount allocated, or a small plot of land for gardening
meanings.exampleEn: He grows vegetables on his allotment every summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yaz kiralık bahçesinde sebze yetiştirir.

meanings.en: a fixed regular payment, often a small salary
meanings.exampleEn: The students receive a monthly stipend for living costs.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler geçim masrafları için aylık bir ödenek alır.

meanings.en: in a way that can be heard
meanings.exampleEn: She sighed audibly when the meeting was extended.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı uzatılınca duyulabilir şekilde iç çekti.

meanings.en: in a voice loud enough to be heard
meanings.exampleEn: He read the poem out loud to the whole class.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiiri tüm sınıfa yüksek sesle okudu.

meanings.en: extremely surprised or shocked
meanings.exampleEn: We were astounded by the size of the ancient temple.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik tapınağın büyüklüğü karşısında hayretler içinde kaldık.

meanings.en: not feeling admiration or interest
meanings.exampleEn: The judges seemed unimpressed by his performance.
meanings.exampleTr: Jüri onun performansından etkilenmemiş görünüyordu.

meanings.en: the combination of parts into a connected whole
meanings.exampleEn: Her theory is a synthesis of several earlier ideas.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun teorisi birkaç önceki fikrin bir sentezidir.

meanings.en: extreme or violent anger
meanings.exampleEn: He slammed the door in a fit of fury.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir öfke nöbeti içinde kapıyı çarptı.

meanings.en: full of energy, determination, or courage
meanings.exampleEn: The team put up a spirited defense in the final.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım finalde ateşli bir savunma sergiledi.

meanings.en: happening once a year or every year
meanings.exampleEn: The company holds a yearly meeting in December.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket aralık ayında yıllık bir toplantı düzenler.

meanings.en: in an anxious or troubled manner
meanings.exampleEn: She glanced worriedly at the clock as time ran out.
meanings.exampleTr: Zaman tükenirken saate endişeyle baktı.

meanings.en: the act of striking the hands together to show approval
meanings.exampleEn: The clapping continued long after the singer left the stage.
meanings.exampleTr: Alkış, şarkıcı sahneden ayrıldıktan çok sonra bile devam etti.

meanings.en: enthusiastic and sustained applause
meanings.exampleEn: The actors received a standing ovation at the end.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncular finalde ayakta coşkulu bir alkış aldı.

meanings.en: to propose someone for a position or award
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to nominate her for the award.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu ödül için aday göstermeye karar verdiler.

meanings.en: groups of soldiers
meanings.exampleEn: The troops were sent to the border overnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Birlikler bir gecede sınıra gönderildi.

meanings.en: to disturb the order or arrangement of something
meanings.exampleEn: The wind began to disarrange her carefully styled hair.
meanings.exampleTr: Rüzgâr, özenle şekillendirdiği saçının düzenini bozmaya başladı.

meanings.en: the act of keeping someone in custody or after school
meanings.exampleEn: The student got detention for being late three times.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenci üç kez geç kaldığı için okulda ceza olarak alıkonuldu.

meanings.en: happening or arriving soon
meanings.exampleEn: We are excited about the coming holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaklaşan tatiller için heyecanlıyız.

meanings.en: lacking artistic taste or quality
meanings.exampleEn: The room had a plain, unartistic appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda sade, sanatsal olmayan bir görünüme sahipti.

meanings.en: to give or allocate a share of something
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher will allot ten minutes for each presentation.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen her sunum için on dakika tahsis edecek.

meanings.en: to separate or disconnect from something
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to dissociate himself from the scandal.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandaldan kendini ayırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to suppose that something is true without proof
meanings.exampleEn: I presume you have already read the report.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu çoktan okuduğunuzu varsayıyorum.

meanings.en: good at or interested in sports; stylish and casual
meanings.exampleEn: She has a sporty figure from years of training.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren antrenmandan dolayı sporcu bir vücudu var.

meanings.en: the character or atmosphere of a place
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant has a warm and relaxing ambience.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoranın sıcak ve rahatlatıcı bir atmosferi var.

meanings.en: to move or travel to a place
meanings.exampleEn: I go to the gym every morning before work.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten önce her sabah spor salonuna giderim.

meanings.en: to be in a particular place
meanings.exampleEn: All students must be present at the morning assembly.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm öğrenciler sabah toplantısında hazır bulunmalıdır.

meanings.en: to attract or tempt by offering something
meanings.exampleEn: The shop used discounts to entice new customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza yeni müşterileri cezbetmek için indirimler kullandı.

meanings.en: to drive back or cause strong dislike
meanings.exampleEn: This spray will repel insects for several hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sprey böcekleri birkaç saat boyunca püskürtecek.

meanings.en: a feeling of strong dislike, or the act of driving back
meanings.exampleEn: She felt a sense of repulsion at the sight of the wound.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarayı görünce bir tiksinti hissetti.

meanings.en: able to be acquired or got
meanings.exampleEn: Tickets are obtainable from the box office only.
meanings.exampleTr: Biletler yalnızca gişeden elde edilebilir.

meanings.en: a wide city street, often lined with trees
meanings.exampleEn: They strolled along the boulevard in the evening sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam güneşinde bulvar boyunca yürüdüler.

meanings.en: aware of or careful about something
meanings.exampleEn: Be mindful of the slippery floor near the entrance.
meanings.exampleTr: Girişin yanındaki kaygan zemine dikkat edin.

meanings.en: a person who looks after children for payment
meanings.exampleEn: They hired a childminder to look after the twins.
meanings.exampleTr: İkizlere bakması için bir çocuk bakıcısı tuttular.

meanings.en: a person employed to care for a family's children
meanings.exampleEn: The nanny took the children to the park every afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Dadı çocukları her öğleden sonra parka götürdü.

meanings.en: pain felt in the back of the body
meanings.exampleEn: Sitting all day gave him terrible back pain.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün gün oturmak ona korkunç bir sırt ağrısı verdi.

meanings.en: a bag carried on the back, used for hiking
meanings.exampleEn: He packed his rucksack and set off into the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Sırt çantasını hazırladı ve dağlara doğru yola çıktı.

meanings.en: a bag carried on the back, especially for travel
meanings.exampleEn: The soldier slung his knapsack over one shoulder.
meanings.exampleTr: Asker çantasını bir omzuna astı.

meanings.en: a building or room where bread is baked
meanings.exampleEn: The village bakehouse filled the street with the smell of fresh bread.
meanings.exampleTr: Köy fırını sokağı taze ekmek kokusuyla doldurdu.

meanings.en: a state of balance between forces or factors
meanings.exampleEn: The body works hard to maintain its equilibrium.
meanings.exampleTr: Vücut dengesini korumak için çok çalışır.

meanings.en: a lack of proportion or balance
meanings.exampleEn: There is a serious imbalance between supply and demand.
meanings.exampleTr: Arz ve talep arasında ciddi bir dengesizlik var.

meanings.en: having no hair
meanings.exampleEn: The newborn animal was completely hairless.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni doğan hayvan tamamen tüysüzdü.

meanings.en: a sauce for salad, or a covering for a wound
meanings.exampleEn: She added a light dressing to the green salad.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeşil salataya hafif bir sos ekledi.

meanings.en: not covered or protected by anything
meanings.exampleEn: The food was left uncovered on the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Yiyecek masanın üzerinde örtüsüz bırakıldı.

meanings.en: having something placed over or on top
meanings.exampleEn: The car was completely covered in snow.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba tamamen karla kaplıydı.

meanings.en: to give a short, sharp cry of pain or excitement
meanings.exampleEn: The dog gave a yelp when it stepped on the thorn.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek dikene basınca acı acı ciyakladı.

meanings.en: a wooden barrel for storing liquids
meanings.exampleEn: The wine was aged in an oak cask for two years.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarap iki yıl boyunca meşe bir fıçıda dinlendirildi.

meanings.en: a small barrel, often used for beer
meanings.exampleEn: They ordered a keg of beer for the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Parti için bir fıçı bira sipariş ettiler.

meanings.en: a space or room just below the roof of a house
meanings.exampleEn: We found old photos stored in the attic.
meanings.exampleTr: Tavan arasında saklanan eski fotoğraflar bulduk.

meanings.en: reasons for something, or the land around a building
meanings.exampleEn: She was dismissed on grounds of misconduct.
meanings.exampleTr: Görevi kötüye kullanma gerekçesiyle işten çıkarıldı.

meanings.en: fighting, especially during a war
meanings.exampleEn: Many soldiers were wounded in close combat.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok asker yakın çarpışmada yaralandı.

meanings.en: an agreement to stop fighting for a period
meanings.exampleEn: The two sides agreed to a temporary truce.
meanings.exampleTr: İki taraf geçici bir ateşkes üzerinde anlaştı.

meanings.en: in a smooth, elegant, or dignified way
meanings.exampleEn: The dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçı sahne boyunca zarifçe hareket etti.

meanings.en: in an extremely good or pleasing way
meanings.exampleEn: The plan worked out wonderfully in the end.
meanings.exampleTr: Plan sonunda harika bir şekilde yürüdü.

meanings.en: to behave badly or improperly
meanings.exampleEn: The children began to misbehave when the teacher left.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen ayrılınca çocuklar yaramazlık yapmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a firm belief, or a formal declaration of guilt
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with great conviction about her cause.
meanings.exampleTr: Davası hakkında büyük bir inançla konuştu.
